mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.workspace_id, b.req_id, b.name, b.status, b.target_branch, b.owner FROM dev_branch b WHERE ORDER BY FIELD(b.status, 'dev', 'testing', 'merging', 'released'), b.updated_at DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{q.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dev_branch b WHERE
SELECT b.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dev_branch b WHERE GROUP BY b.status
SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, b.created_at, b.released_at)) / 86400.0 FROM dev_branch b WHERE AND b.status = 'released' AND b.released_at IS NOT NULL AND b.created_at IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS task_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.board_column = 'done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS done_count FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.branch_id = #{branchId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')

SELECT t.branch_id AS branchId, pv.id AS versionId, pv.name AS name, pv.status AS status, pv.req_id AS reqId, r.name AS reqName FROM task t INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = pv.req_id AND r.workspace_id = pv.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL
AND t.branch_id IN #{bid}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
GROUP BY t.branch_id, pv.id, pv.name, pv.status, pv.req_id, r.name ORDER BY r.name, pv.name

SELECT pv.id AS versionId, pv.name AS name, pv.status AS status, pv.req_id AS reqId, r.name AS reqName, COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) AS count FROM dev_branch b INNER JOIN task t ON t.branch_id = b.id AND t.workspace_id = b.workspace_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL INNER JOIN version_task vt ON vt.task_id = t.id AND vt.workspace_id = t.workspace_id INNER JOIN project_version pv ON pv.id = vt.version_id AND pv.workspace_id = t.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = pv.req_id AND r.workspace_id = pv.workspace_id WHERE
GROUP BY pv.id, pv.name, pv.status, pv.req_id, r.name ORDER BY r.name, pv.name

SELECT t.branch_id AS branchId, r.id AS projectId, r.name AS projectName FROM task t INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = t.workspace_id WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.branch_id IS NOT NULL AND t.req_id IS NOT NULL
AND t.branch_id IN #{bid}
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.workspace_id = t.workspace_id AND pm.project_id = t.req_id AND pm.user_id = #{viewerId} AND pm.access = 'none')
GROUP BY t.branch_id, r.id, r.name ORDER BY r.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, status, owner, owner_user_id, target_branch, note, dev_at, test_at, merge_at, released_at, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{ownerUserId}, #{targetBranch}, #{note}, #{devAt}, #{testAt}, #{mergeAt}, #{releasedAt}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET name = #{name}, req_id = #{reqId}, owner = #{owner}, owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}, target_branch = #{targetBranch}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() , dev_at = COALESCE(dev_at, NOW()) , test_at = COALESCE(test_at, NOW()) , merge_at = COALESCE(merge_at, NOW()) , released_at = COALESCE(released_at, NOW()) WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

UPDATE dev_branch b JOIN dev_branch pub ON pub.workspace_id = b.workspace_id AND pub.req_id IS NULL AND pub.name = b.name SET b.name = CONCAT(LEFT(b.name, 79 - CHAR_LENGTH(b.req_id)), '-', b.req_id) WHERE b.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND b.req_id = #{reqId}
UPDATE dev_branch SET req_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dev_branch WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dev_branch_log (id, workspace_id, branch_id, action, from_status, to_status, detail, actor_name, actor_user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{branchId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{detail}, #{actorName}, #{actorUserId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dev_branch_log WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
mapper.update: UPDATE dev_branch SET owner_user_id = NULL WHERE owner_user_id = #{userId}
